Hello. I am sure I will not be the only one to say that there are a lot of jobs that are being lost to AI, it may not destroy them completely but they going to need way less people for the film and video game industry. Graphic designers also are losing ground because people now make their own logo, presentations, flyers, visuals with AI. It's cheaper and faster and you can get a lot more ideas out fast. Even if people don't have degrees in art and don't understand what logo would be best for their company because of color choice, font choice etc.. they do not care as long as it cheap. So all the small companies that were hiring graphic designer to do things like that for them is going to disappear more and more. Illustrations for books and other things like that also. I am guessing any job that required people to enter data or finding data will be extremely reduced. There might be of one or two people needed to do the job of 10-20 people. I like your videos and the way you explain things, I do agree that using AI makes you more powerful and capable of much more and not using it will put you behind. However I am truly concern about job stability which leads to financial stability. AI isn't going to stop and people aren't going to stop using it. Saying that it won't take jobs just because it just takes annoying tasks away is just not accurate. Even your hook or pyramid example, a 3d artist could have made your hook in 15 minutes but you didn't hire a 3d artist to do it. You did it yourself so by using AI you took away a job that an artist could have done. I am not saying you were wrong to do so but that just proves that artists using computers unfortunately will become less and less of a viable job position. Again, I like your content in general and I hope you continue making more videos.
